summary: Netcapital Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement with Labrys Fund II, L.P. on June 4, 2026. The company issued a $145,000 promissory note (purchase price $125,000, net proceeds $111,250 after discounts and fees) and a warrant to purchase 125,000 shares at $0.50/share. The unsecured note matures June 3, 2027, with amortization payments starting December 2026. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation; the filing details a private placement of debt and warrants to an institutional investor, with no change of control, strategic event, or shareholder vote. It is categorized as None.
